evidence.reason: qemu_command resolves the run directory and interpolates it directly into -drive file=... options without escaping or rejecting commas. QEMU's -drive parser treats commas as option separators, with embedded commas requiring doubling, so a state directory such as `probe,local` makes the file value split and the drive option malformed. This is an ordinary correctness defect; either reject comma-containing run paths before preparation or double commas in the QEMU option values.
